arms_crossed_jaw_tight.cau: A person crosses both arms tightly across the upper abdomen with the right arm tucking under the left.

both_hands_chest_greeting.cau: A person presses both palms together at chest height with fingertips pointing upward and dips the head forward.

bow_greeting.cau: A person performs a respectful greeting bow, tilting the head and upper body forward and rising back up.

bow_head_agree.cau: A person folds both hands at waist level and bows the torso forward about 15 degrees.

bow_head_respect.cau: A person slowly bends their torso forward about 18 degrees with head naturally following then returns upright.

chest_lift_chin_up_proud.cau: A person lifts their chest forward and raises their chin upward by fifteen degrees.

climax_fist_hold_overhead.cau: A person raises their right fist steadily from waist level to forehead height.

come_here_family_beckon.cau: A person curls their right hand fingers downward repeatedly at chest height toward themselves.

cover_mouth_embarrassed.cau: A person raises the right hand upward in a smooth motion to cover the mouth and lower nose.

cup_both_hands_offer_forward.cau: A person raises both cupped upward-facing hands from waist level to chest height.

deflate_drop.cau: A person flips their right palm downward from shoulder height and drops the hand quickly to hip level.

double_fist_tap_together.cau: A person brings both fists together in a firm tap at the body midline.

excited_rise_both_arms_overhead.cau: A person sweeps both arms upward from their sides until both hands reach fully overhead.

explosive_stand_ground.cau: A person straightens both legs fully and locks their spine upright pulling both shoulders back firmly.

finger_kiss.cau: A person brings pinched right fingertips to their lips then flicks the fingers open outward.

firm_nod_promise.cau: A person flexes their neck downward twenty-five degrees in a single deliberate nod with spine rigid.

hands_clasp_resolve.cau: A person raises both arms and clasps the hands together at sternum level with crossed forearms.

handshake_offer.cau: A person extends their right hand forward at waist height with palm facing inward and elbow slightly bent.

head_drop_chin.cau: A person slowly drops their head forward until the chin nearly touches the chest.

head_tilt_soft_wonder.cau: A person tilts the head to the right while raising the left hand open-palmed to waist height.

index_finger_point_you.cau: A person raises their right arm to shoulder height and extends the index finger pointing directly forward.

lean_back_disbelief_head_shake.cau: A person leans torso back onto the left heel while the head shakes side to side.

open_palm_offer.cau: A person extends their right arm forward with palm turned upward toward the listener.

pivot_heel_think.cau: A person pivots the right heel outward while the left arm crosses over the torso.

point_abstract_space.cau: A person extends their right index finger toward a fixed point in the air at chest height.

point_upward_ideal.cau: A person raises the right arm upward with the index finger pointing toward the ceiling above head level.

press_temples_confused.cau: A person raises both hands and presses their fingertips against both temples while bowing their head slightly.

raise_hand_request.cau: A person raises their right arm forward to shoulder height with palm facing outward.

rub_back_of_neck.cau: A person brings their right hand behind their head to cup and lightly rub the.

run_in_a_circle.cau: A person runs in a circle.

scratch_head_sheepish.cau: A person scratches the right fingertips in a small circle on the back-right scalp.

shoulder_shrug_palms_up_weight_shift.cau: A person raises both shoulders while both forearms rotate upward with palms facing up.

shy_retreat_half_step_hug_self.cau: A person steps the right foot back and wraps both arms across the chest in a self-embrace.

step_back_cross_arms_light.cau: A person loads weight onto the left heel and crosses both forearms at the lower chest.

thumbs_up.cau: A person raises their right fist to chest level and extends the thumb straight upward.

wave_hand_dismiss.cau: A person raises their right hand to waist height and flicks the wrist left with palm facing down.

zip_lips.cau: A person drags their right thumb and index finger pinched together across the lips from left to right.
